info.title: ShadouCMDB API
info.description:
REST API for ShadouCMDB. This API is the only database client; the web UI uses nothing else.

- Collections are paginated with `limit`/`offset` and return `{ data, page: { limit, offset, total } }`.
- `sort=field` ascending, `sort=-field` descending. `q` searches. Filters that take ids accept comma-separated lists.
- Every error uses the `ErrorEnvelope` shape; invalid input is always 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with per-field `details`.
- Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session travels in the `shadoucmdb_session` cookie. Every operation except the health probes, login and first-run setup answers 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` without a live session.
- POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE also need the `X-CSRF-Token` header (the `csrfToken` from login or `/api/v1/auth/me`, also in the `shadoucmdb_csrf` cookie); without it: 403 `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.
- Permissions come from the permission profiles a user holds. A missing global permission (named in each operation's description) or class permission (view/create/edit/delete) answers 403 `FORBIDDEN`. Lists only contain CIs of classes the user may view.
- Writes are recorded in the audit log (`/api/v1/audit-log`) with the signed-in user as the actor.
- Send `X-Request-Id` to correlate a request; it is echoed back and stored with audit rows.

servers.description: Same origin the document was fetched from

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up (does not touch the database)
Readiness: database reachable and all migrations applied
get.description: Returns 200 with status "ready" only when the database answers and every migration in this build is applied; otherwise 503 with the same body shape.

503.description: Not ready: database unreachable or migrations pending

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is needed (no users exist yet)

post.summary: Create the first administrator and sign them in (only while no users exist)
post.description: The new user holds the built-in Administrator profile. 409 once any user exists. Sets the session and CSRF cookies. `shadoucmdb create-admin` does the same from the command line.

400.description: Invalid input (code VALIDATION_ERROR) with per-field details

409.description: Conflict: CONFLICT (duplicate or not allowed in this state), IN_USE, VERSION_CONFLICT or LAST_ADMINISTRATOR

post.summary: Sign in with username and password
post.description: Sets the `shadoucmdb_session` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure behind HTTPS) and the `shadoucmdb_csrf` cookie. 401 for a wrong username or password. After 5 failures for a username, each further failure locks it for 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, ... up to 15 min; while locked the answer is 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

400.description: Invalid input (code VALIDATION_ERROR) with per-field details

401.description: Not signed in, session expired, or wrong credentials (code UNAUTHENTICATED)

429.description: Too many failed sign-ins (code RATE_LIMITED); see the Retry-After header

post.summary: Sign out: end this session and clear its cookies

get.summary: Relationship graph around a CI in one call (nodes + edges)
get.description: Breadth-first traversal of live relationships up to `depth` hops. For a Server -> Application -> Database view, ask from the application with `direction=outgoing`, or from the server with `direction=both&depth=2`. Needs view on the root's class; CIs of classes the caller may not view are left out (and not traversed).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: outgoing follows source->target (app -> runs_on -> server); incoming the reverse; symmetric types are always followed

parameters.name: maxNodes
parameters.description: Stop expanding once this many CIs are collected

get.summary: Global search across CIs, ranked, with the fields that matched
get.description: Matches name, hostname and serial number (substring), IP address (prefix, or containment when `q` is an IP or CIDR), notes (word prefix) and attribute values (text/enum substring, IP/CIDR prefix). Exact matches rank first, then name prefix, then trigram similarity. Only CIs in classes the caller may view.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes for orchestrators and load balancers.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: First-run setup, sign-in with a local username and password, sign-out, and the current user's permissions.

tags.name: Configuration items
tags.description: CIs: the tracked assets. Includes the relationship graph around a CI.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Global search across CIs and their attribute values.

tags.name: Relationships
tags.description: Typed, directional edges between CIs. Removal is a soft delete.

tags.name: CI classes
tags.description: CI types in an inheritance tree. Adding a class is data entry, not a migration. Changing the data model needs datamodel.manage.

tags.name: Attribute definitions
tags.description: Typed custom fields per class, inherited by subclasses.

tags.name: Relationship types
tags.description: Relationship types (runs_on, depends_on, ...) and the rules for which classes they may connect.

tags.name: Owners
tags.description: People and teams accountable for CIs.

tags.name: Lookup lists
tags.description: Lists an administrator defines (e.g. "Support contract") whose values "lookup" attributes store.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: Administration: starter data models (classes, attributes, relationship rules and lookups) installed on a bare database.

tags.name: Audit log
tags.description: Read-only change history written in the same transaction as every change.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Administration: local user accounts, passwords and the permission profiles they hold.

tags.name: Permission profiles
tags.description: Administration: named sets of global and per-CI-class permissions. Users can hold several; the built-in Administrator profile holds everything.
